ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.eLogix_Bypass_Validation_Rules), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Delivery_Status__c, "Delivered"), ISPICKVAL(Delivery_Status__c, "Partially Delivered")), OR(ISBLANK(Receiver_Name__c), ISBLANK(Delivery_Date__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A completed delivery must record the receiver name and delivery date.
